name: AI automation ownership comparison source card
buyer_pain_phrases: AI automation vs MSP vs in-house
how to reduce repetitive manual work
AI workflow exception handling and rollback
buyer_question: Before buying an AI tool, MSP service or hiring an internal team, how can an operator decide who should own the workflow, exceptions, access boundary, human review and rollback?
aics_positioning: AICloudStrategist is positioned as a bounded, no-credentials owner-evidence and diagnostic-readiness layer for deciding whether a workflow is ready for automation, managed service support or internal ownership.
what_buyers_can_reuse: Three-path comparison of AI automation, an MSP and an in-house team.
Five-question hold rule for workflow clarity, allowed inputs, exceptions, reversal and smallest reversible test.
Ownership fields for workflow, access boundary, escalation, rollback and next review.
Explicit boundary separating synthetic buyer education from customer outcome evidence.
safe_first_review_inputs: non-confidential screenshots with personal data removed
do_not_send_initially: personal, medical, legal or financial data
claim_boundaries: synthetic decision aid and buyer-education asset only
not a client case study, testimonial, certification, compliance opinion or vendor ranking
no productivity, savings, ROI, revenue, demand, lead, customer or AI-accuracy claim
no legal, privacy, security, employment or operational advice
recommended_next_step: Use the comparison and hold rule to document one workflow, one owner, one exception path and one stop condition before choosing a tool, MSP or hiring plan.
